summary: All seven repair targets are invalid because they request removal of priority markers that the Draft QA Rules require on requirement-like qa entries.

items.title: 1. Remove Answer Prefix
items.rationale: The must prefix is a required priority marker, not an answer or rationale embedded in the pending question.
items.evidence: The active plan.draft instructions require every requirement-like qa entry to include exactly one of must, should, or nice-to-have; draft.json qa[0] contains only the question plus empty answer fields.
